title: Hoshino Ichika — No Answers Tonight〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Alleyway

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But given the overarching theme, this just isn't going to work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, are you saying...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A melody I came up with isn't going to work?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I... I shouldn't have been so blunt with Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Why is nothing going right...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I was so sure that Saki would understand...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Even if we disagreed slightly on what we wanted our song to be about, I thought we'd be able to talk things out and produce something good...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But now...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I regret not thinking this through more...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I didn't realize how hard it would be to write a song with someone.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki has her own style in terms of music, and so do I...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That's completely normal...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I honestly don't know how our song is going to turn out now...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What are we supposed to do?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If coming up with melodies together and swapping chord progressions didn't work...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh...
What if we started over by writing some lyrics...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That might help make things go smoother...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (No, wait...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That isn't the answer...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm thinking about the wrong thing...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I mean...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki cares deeply about showing empathy to our listeners.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We're disagreeing on how to express that fundamental aspect, so writing lyrics will probably just lead to another argument...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I thought I understood what Saki meant by showing our listeners empathy...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But keeping it all sad and gloomy seems like the wrong way to go...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I haven't been able to get through to her...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Even when I did try to mold my ideas to fit hers, I just didn't see the song getting any better...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I thought I really liked her songs...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
The more I think about this, the less I know what we're supposed to do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I've heard that it's common for bands to fight over what they want their music to be about. Does this count...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I never thought that we'd ever end up fighting like this, but I was wrong...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Am I more stubborn than I realize...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Still, brooding all by myself like this isn't going to solve anything...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki and I write music in different ways...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (So we're just going to have to talk things out...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I don't know if we'll be able to reach a resolution by doing so...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I think that's our only option right now...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (If we want to produce a good song...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll head back once I've finished drinking this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She'll probably start wondering where I've gone if I don't soon...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'll go back, collect my thoughts and resume our discussion...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Things might go south again...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But Saki and I need to talk about this.
